dedupe_keys.name: carta del piano generale di utilizzazione delle acque pubbliche della pericolosita di esondazione

description: Carta del Piano Generale di Utilizzazione delle Acque Pubbliche della Pericolosita di esondazione is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by siatservices.provincia.tn.it. Flood hazard (PGUAP risk map). On 27 October 2014 the Provincial Executive approved the seventh update of the risk maps of the General Plan for the Use of Public Waters, which entered into force on 5 November 2014, i.e. the day following its publication in BUR No 44 of 5 November 2014. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Map of the General Plan of Use of Public Flood Hazard Waters" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include PGUAP, RNDT, PERICOLOSITA', SIAT, open data, ESONDAZIONE. The listing shows 2014-10-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
